title: True evaluation of an OR node
statement: For any natural number $n$, list $cs$ of circuits on $n$ variables, and assignment $x$ to those variables, the OR node with children $cs$ evaluates to true if and only if there exists a circuit in $cs$ that evaluates to true under $x$.
